major_cooldowns.name: Stasis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it on cooldown and store the default Dream Breath, Temporal Anomaly, Merithra's Blessing combo, always ending on Temporal Anomaly so its free Echoes are not eaten by a later stored spell.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Ability table lists this cast id as 'Stasis (Store)'; the guide labels the same id 'Stasis'. 370562 is the aura. 370537 is the cast id; Warcraft Logs labels it "Stasis (Store)".

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as often as possible and line it up with your Stasis cast; as Chronowarden the Temporal Burst haste and cooldown recovery it grants is heavily front-loaded, so press it the moment a hard window starts.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Chronoboon reduces the cooldown by 30s when talented; 120 is the base value from the tooltip.

major_cooldowns.name: Rewind
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it immediately after an extremely heavy damage window, since it heals off damage taken in the last 5 seconds; use it as soon as you are falling behind rather than holding it for a perfect moment.

major_cooldowns.name: Dream Flight
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fly through as many stacked allies as possible, ideally into a window where both the burst healing and the 15 second HoT land on real damage, but send it rather than banking it.

major_cooldowns.name: Dream Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open every ramp with it at Rank 1 to guarantee a Merithra's Blessing proc, saving higher ranks for emergencies where the extra healing keeps someone alive.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 355941 is the HoT aura, 376788 the echoed copy; 355936 is the 30s cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown during downtime for damage and to arm Leaping Flames, then follow with Living Flame at max empower rank to convert it into 1-2 Essence Bursts.

defensives.name: Obsidian Scales
defensives.usage_rule: Press it for 30% damage reduction ahead of any hit aimed at you, and with Renewing Blaze it heals back everything it prevented over 8 seconds.

defensives.name: Zephyr
defensives.usage_rule: Use it a few seconds before a known area-of-effect hit for 20% reduction on you and your 4 nearest allies; single-target damage gets nothing from it, so check what the mechanic actually deals.

defensives.name: Time Dilation
defensives.usage_rule: Pre-cast it on yourself or the player about to eat a large hit so 50% of that damage is spread over 8 seconds and becomes healable.

rules.action: Build Echoes with Temporal Anomaly first, then close the ramp on Merithra's Blessing so it consumes them and lands Reversion on every player who had an Echo.

rules.description: Emerald Blossom only with Essence Burst up
rules.action: Save Emerald Blossom for an Essence Burst proc: it costs 3 Essence against Echo's 2 and has a very high mana cost, and the free cast still stacks Twin Echoes twice.

rules.description: Spend Essence Burst on Echo or Emerald Blossom
rules.action: Never let an Essence Burst expire. Default to Emerald Blossom for the free 3 Essence and the Twin Echoes stacks, and take Echo instead when you need Echoes out fast mid-ramp.

rules.description: Tip the Scales paired with Stasis
rules.action: Line Tip the Scales up with your Stasis cast so the stored empowers go out instantly at max rank while Temporal Burst haste is at its peak.

rules.description: Verdant Embrace right after Merithra's Blessing
rules.action: Slot Verdant Embrace between ramps: finish on Merithra's Blessing, spend down to zero Essence, then cast it so you lose no Echoes and reach max Primacy stacks before the next Dream Breath.

source_summary: Preservation gameplay is a ramp loop: open with Dream Breath at Rank 1 to guarantee a Merithra's Blessing proc, flood the raid with Echoes through Temporal Anomaly and Essence spenders, then cash them in on Merithra's Blessing. Stasis is the spec's throughput cooldown, stored as Dream Breath, Temporal Anomaly, Merithra's Blessing and paired with Tip the Scales, while Rewind is the reactive button pressed straight after a heavy damage window rather than banked. Essence discipline drives the rest: every Essence Burst goes into Emerald Blossom or Echo, and Fire Breath plus Living Flame fills downtime to keep generating more.
